entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act under the
ancestors: DIVISION B—COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 537.  None of the funds made available by this Act under the 
heading ``Pacific Coastal Salmon Recovery'' may be used for

[[Page 128 STAT. 2217]]

grant guidelines or requirements to establish minimum riparian buffers.
